headline: Russia's response to attacks on the Crimea bridge leaves 8 dead
summary: Russia struck three bridges in Kyiv with nighttime missile attacks, according to Ukrainian authorities. The strikes killed six people in the capital and two more in other locations.
why: Attacks on transport infrastructure disrupt logistics and energy flows, raising geopolitical risk premiums for Ukraine, Russia and European markets.
original_headline: Respuesta de Rusia a los ataques contra el puente de Crimea deja 8 muertos
